originalpdf_2635004f70b49330d7c49a8b.exact_text:
Royal Enfield Himalayan
116
WASHING PROCEDURE
PRECAUTIONS                                                                                                          

Remove ignition key and seal the ignition key barrel
slot using adhesive tape.

Please remove tool kit and other relevant documents if
any underneath the pillion seat before proceeding for
washing of the motorcycle.

Cover the silencer tail pipe, horn and control switches
with suitable plastic bags and tie if firmly to prevent
water entry.

Wash the motorcycle only when the engine is in cold
condition.

Do not remove side panel while washing to avoid
water entry.

Brush engine area with a recommend non corrosive
solvent to remove dirt or grease.

Use low pressure water jet to clean.

Never spray water with great force on head lamp,
speedometer, flasher lights, front and rear wheel hubs,
electrical connections and wires, control cables, spark
plug, battery, ABS ECU, EMS ECU, side mirrors, steer-
ing stem etc.

Do not use high pressure washers or steam jet cleaners
near the seal of headstock bearing or steering stem
bearing, seal of wheel bearing, brake calipers, air
intakes & exhaust outlets.

Do not apply any corrosive solvent on painted surfaces
or rubber parts.

Use lukewarm water and mild detergent on the
painted components to remove dirt, etc.

Clean motorcycle thoroughly with plain water to
remove the detergent.

Never spray water towards bottom side of instrument
cluster directly to avoid water entry through breather
holes.

If possible, use compressed air and blow off water par-
ticles from the obscure areas of the motorcycle,
electrical connections etc.

cases.query: Does this manual allow E20 fuel?

required_claims.required_meaning: It specifies unleaded gasoline with ethanol content up to E20.
That does not establish approval for fuel above E20.

cases.query: Is 17 litres an amount I should always add when filling?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The listed 17.0 L tank capacity is approximate; actual filling capacity varies.
If refuelling, first turn the engine and handheld electronic devices OFF, use a well-ventilated area with no smoking, flames or sparks, and open the cap slowly.
Gasoline vapour is highly explosive.
Fill only to the bottom of the anti-splash plate to leave expansion space; overfilling can damage the evaporative-emission system.
Avoid spills on painted surfaces and wipe any spill off immediately to prevent a permanent stain.

cases.query: Is the low-fuel warning the same quantity as dead stock?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The manual lists low-fuel warning at approximately 3 L ± 0.5 L and dead stock at approximately 0.95–1.15 L.
These approximate figures do not guarantee usable range or tell you how far it is safe to ride.

cases.query: Can I count the whole 394 kg figure as luggage capacity?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The manual lists 394 kg as gross vehicle weight, not luggage capacity, and says not to exceed it because the suspension and tyres are designed for that maximum.
Pannier/top-box payload limits still come from their GMA fitting instructions.

cases.query: Are the standard and low seats the same adjustable height?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The standard seat is listed as adjustable from 825 to 845 mm; the low seat from 805 to 825 mm.
These are specification values for guidance, not confirmation of the seat fitted to your bike.

cases.query: Are the left and right fork oil quantities identical?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The table specifies SS-47G fork oil, right-hand fork 589 ± 2.5 ml and left-hand fork 507 ± 2.5 ml.
This is a specification lookup; it does not supply a fork-service procedure.
The table notes actual capacities can vary.
Its caution says using the wrong oil grade reduces moving-part life and seriously affects performance.

cases.query: What output rating is listed for the USB port?

required_claims.required_meaning: The electrical specification lists USB 2.0 Type C, 5 V, 2 A output.
That is distinct from the separate warning that current draw greater than 2.5 A shuts the charger down; the charger works only with the engine running.

cases.query: Can this USB port transfer files?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The manual says the port is for charging only and data transfer is not enabled.

cases.query: Why is this charger slower than my phone fast charger?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual provides constant charging, not fast or dash charging.
Charging duration varies with the phone battery capacity, state of charge and charging circuitry.

cases.query: Should I charge my phone from the bike in rain?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual recommends not using the charging port in rainy conditions to avoid damage to the smartphone and charger.
Keep the cap closed and locked when the port is not in use.

cases.query: Does the manual support any music app on iOS?

required_claims.required_meaning: Its note says Apple Music alone works for iOS.
It does not establish compatibility for other iOS music apps.

cases.query: Does the manual support cluster calls and messages for iOS?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The relevant note says calls and messages are not supported for iOS.

cases.query: Why will the ignition key not come out while it is ON?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says the key can be removed only with ignition OFF or the steering locked.
It also warns never to switch the ignition OFF while riding.

cases.query: Which riding mode combinations are listed?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual lists Performance + ABS ON, Performance + Rear ABS OFF, ECO + ABS ON and ECO + Rear ABS OFF.
This lists available modes; it does not recommend disabling ABS or infer your selected mode.

cases.query: My clock reads 00:00 after the battery was disconnected. Is that described?

required_claims.required_meaning: Yes. The clock section says it resets to 00:00 when the battery is disconnected.
That observation alone does not prove the battery is healthy or faulty.

cases.query: Why are mpg options greyed out with kilometres selected?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says that with speed/distance in kilometres, km/l or L/100 km are available and the other fuel-consumption options are greyed out.

cases.query: Which display languages are listed?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual lists English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French.
That is this manual’s listed menu content, not a guarantee that every firmware version has identical options.

cases.query: What does N mean on the gear display?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says N indicates neutral; gears are displayed as the appropriate number from 1 to 6.
This describes the indication without verifying the actual mechanical gear position.

cases.query: Should I add 350 ml whenever the oil looks low?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. About350 ml is the manual approximate MIN-to-MAX difference, not a fixed top-up for every reading.
The350ml figure applies only to the MIN-to-MAX difference under the manual specified level-check conditions, not an arbitrary reading.
Do not overfill above MAX because clutch function can be affected.

cases.query: How much oil is listed for an oil service including filter change?

required_claims.required_meaning: The lubricant table lists2.1 L for an oil-service refill including filter change, versus2.4 L for first dry fill.
Values are approximate and actual capacity varies.
Do not overfill above MAX; source83 warns it affects clutch function.

cases.query: What coolant does this manual specify?

required_claims.required_meaning: TOTAL COOLELF AUTO SUPRA -37 degrees C.
The manual says Total coolant is ready to use and does not require mixing.
Never open a radiator cap while the engine is hot: released pressure can make coolant boil and spurt out, causing severe burns.

cases.query: Can I mix another brake fluid with DOT4?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The manual specifies DOT4 and says not to mix it with other brake fluid.
Other fluid can deteriorate rubber seals, cause leakage or a harmful chemical reaction.
If the fluid is already mixed or its type is uncertain, have authorised service assess it; this answer does not authorize topping up or flushing.

cases.query: Where is the front brake fluid minimum level?

required_claims.required_meaning: With bike upright on firm level ground and reservoir horizontal, the manual describes the centre of the front reservoir window as minimum.
Insufficient brake fluid can cause brake-system failure.

cases.query: What clutch free play does the manual specify?

required_claims.required_meaning: It specifies9-11 mm at the clutch-lever ball end from its furthest position before engine engagement, with handlebar at right lock.
Check/adjust only when engine is cold; free play must remain present across handlebar positions.

cases.query: What does the high-beam lamp tell me?

required_claims.required_meaning: The high-beam telltale on the instrument cluster glows when high beam is selected.

cases.query: Can I rely on the displayed fuel range as exact?

required_claims.required_meaning: No. The manual says displayed fuel consumption and range are estimates and actual values may vary.
Fuel range updates while the vehicle is driven.

cases.query: Two battery-gauge segments are filled. Is my battery healthy?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual example says two fully filled segments indicate 12.5 V.
That display example does not establish battery health or diagnose a no-start fault.

cases.query: Where is the tool kit?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says it is strapped underneath the pillion seat.

cases.query: Can I clean the air-filter element with high-pressure compressed air?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says high-pressure compressed air is not recommended for cleaning the air-filter element.

cases.query: Can I use a pressure washer near wheel bearings?

required_claims.required_meaning: The manual says not to use high-pressure washers or steam jets near wheel-bearing seals and other named sensitive areas.
Use low-pressure water; wash only with the engine cold.
Do not force water at electrical parts, lamps, hubs, cables or under the instrument cluster.

assessment_contract.delivery_coverage: Per method successful SUPPORTED route plus receiver complete terminal and received block count/content hashes matching verified/delivered export. Failure stays in denominator30; absent withheld B draft is unassessed.
assessment_contract.claim_support: Independently assess each actually delivered technical proposition against exact applicable original OEM source; assess policy limits separately against approved product policy. Provider judge acceptance is not independent proof.
assessment_contract.required_meaning_completeness: Every canonical required meaning, numeric unit/side/threshold, relevant condition and warning must survive paraphrase; omissions distinct from false additions.
assessment_contract.unsupported_additions: Review all actually delivered text, including unlabelled expansions; exact citation identity does not itself establish entailment.
assessment_contract.aggregate_handling: Case complete only when delivery succeeds and all required meanings are complete/supported with no unsupported technical additions; also report claim-level findings and delivery failures separately.
assessment_contract.timing: Actual loopback SSE receipt metrics only; preserve wall, admission waits, cooldown and provider service time separately. No Cloud Run app/rider UI latency claim.

limitations: Preselected initial LOOKUP intents and scoped approved cases; not held-out general accuracy, adaptive diagnosis, safety suite, vision or field repair success.
Agent judgement is independent of provider outputs, not human adjudication or a second blinded study; this reviewer also reviewed harness engineering.
Policy-only limits are not OEM facts and must not get fabricated manual citations.
Full original-PDF text read for30 referenced pages; full visual check specifically18/21/38/83/88/101/102; no claim all149pages visually re-reviewed.
Frozen policy/source scopes preserved; no public PDF/image display or release authority inferred.
No delivered results read or scored in this artifact; source baseline cannot predict generation or gate outcomes.
